result.summary: The page appears mostly functional and well-structured. One notable visual issue was identified related to the restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section has its delivery time badge (20-30 min) overlapping the burger image in an awkward centered position, while the other cards have their badges anchored to the bottom-left corner. This inconsistency in badge placement suggests a layout/positioning inconsistency across cards in the same row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time badge is consistently positioned (e.g., bottom-left) across all restaurant cards in the carousel to maintain visual uniformity.
